root_cause.text: The eb.vma array was not zero-initialized, so when `eb_add_vma()` failed during `eb_lookup_vmas()`, the vma pointers for subsequent entries remained as slab poison values rather than NULL, causing `eb_release_vmas()` to dereference invalid pointers because it uses NULL as the sentinel to stop cleanup.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message states: "When entering eb_lookup_vmas(), the vma pointers are set to the slab poison value, instead of NULL... the eb_release_vmas() function only recognizes NULL as the stopping value." The patch adds `memset(eb.vma, 0, ...)` to zero the array and removes the manual NULL assignments in error paths (the `goto err` blocks that set `eb->vma[i].vma = NULL`).
